debate.key_bull_argument: Multiple MA golden crosses (EMA 9/21, SMA 9/21), Ichimoku TK cross-up, 15x volume spike, and price above all short-term MAs create strong short-term bullish confluence with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear regime.
